📖 How to use

  1. Choose 2D or 3D vectors.
  2. Enter the components of vector v and vector w.
  3. Pick an operation: add, subtract, dot product, cross product, angle or magnitude.
  4. Read the result with the component-by-component working.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is the dot product?

The dot product v·w = x₁x₂ + y₁y₂ + z₁z₂ is a scalar measuring how much two vectors point in the same direction. It is zero exactly when the vectors are perpendicular.

What is the cross product?

The cross product v×w is a vector perpendicular to both inputs, with magnitude |v||w|sin θ. For 2D vectors the tool returns the scalar z-component.

How is the angle between vectors found?

From cos θ = (v·w) / (|v| × |w|). The tool reports θ in degrees.
